content.user_title: Analyze Therapeutic ML Data with PyTDC
content.value_statement: Drug discovery teams need consistent datasets and fair benchmarks. This skill guides PyTDC workflows for loading data, splitting datasets, evaluating models, and using molecular oracles.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to load TDC single-prediction, multi-prediction, and generation datasets.
Shows scaffold, random, cold-drug, cold-target, and temporal split strategies.
Documents ADME, toxicity, DTI, DDI, PPI, MolGen, and retrosynthesis task families.
Guides benchmark group evaluation with five seeds and standardized metrics.
Covers molecular oracle use for QED, SA, LogP, GSK3B, JNK3, DRD2, and related scores.
Includes example scripts for loading data, benchmark evaluation, and molecular generation.
limitations: It does not train production models for the user.
It requires PyTDC and task-specific dependencies in the user environment.
Some datasets or oracles may download data or require external API access.
Oracle scores are predictions and require experimental validation.

use_cases.title: Prepare ADME Experiments
use_cases.description: Load ADME datasets, choose scaffold splits, and select metrics for realistic model evaluation.

use_cases.title: Run Benchmark Comparisons
use_cases.description: Follow TDC benchmark group protocols with five seeds and comparable summary metrics.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Generated Molecules
use_cases.description: Use molecular oracles to score generated compounds for drug-likeness, synthesis, and target activity.

prompt_templates.title: Load a Dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose and load a PyTDC dataset for an ADME prediction task. Explain the data columns and recommended split.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Split Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare scaffold, random, cold-drug, and cold-target splits for my therapeutic ML task. Recommend one and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Benchmark Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PyTDC benchmark evaluation plan for my model using the five-seed protocol, metrics, and result reporting format.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Molecules with Oracles
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define a multi-objective molecular oracle workflow using QED, SA, LogP, and a target activity score.

output_examples.input: I need an ADME dataset for intestinal permeability.
output_examples.output: Recommended dataset: Caco2_Wang. Use a scaffold split for chemical diversity and report MAE for regression performance.

output_examples.input: I want to compare my model on a TDC benchmark group.
output: Use the ADMET benchmark group for related pharmacokinetic and toxicity tasks.
Run the required five seeds without changing the official splits.
Report mean and standard deviation for each dataset.

output_examples.input: I generated molecules and need quick quality checks.
output_examples.output: Score the molecules with QED, SA, LogP, and task-specific activity oracles. Treat high-scoring candidates as screening leads only.

best_practices: Use scaffold or cold splits when the test set should represent unseen chemistry.
Run multiple seeds and report both mean performance and variation.
Validate oracle-ranked molecules with domain review and experimental evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not compare models across different split methods without clearly reporting the difference.
Do not treat oracle scores as experimental measurements.
Do not tune on benchmark test data or modify official benchmark splits.

faq.question: What is PyTDC?
faq.answer: PyTDC is the Python interface for Therapeutics Data Commons, a collection of datasets and benchmarks for therapeutic machine learning.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does this skill include runnable examples?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes example scripts for dataset loading, benchmark evaluation, and molecular generation with oracles.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Some PyTDC datasets, documentation links, and oracles may require downloads or external API access.

faq.question: Can it validate new drug candidates?
faq.answer: No. It can guide computational scoring, but experimental validation and expert review are still required.

faq.question: What tasks are covered?
faq.answer: It covers single-prediction, multi-prediction, and generation tasks, including ADME, toxicity, DTI, DDI, MolGen, and retrosynthesis.
